description: This file contains tests for the 'Note' functionality of an agent, including sending notes via HTTP, formatting messages, handling tags, URL conversion, authorization headers, and concurrency behavior.

methods.name: TestNote_Basic
methods.description: Tests basic sending of a note, verifying payload contents and headers.

methods.name: TestNote_NoTags
methods.description: Verifies behavior when no tags are provided.

methods.name: TestNote_NoAgentFieldURL
methods.description: Ensures no sending occurs if AgentFieldURL is not configured.

methods.name: TestNote_ServerError
methods.description: Checks handling of server errors during note sending.

methods.name: TestNote_URLConversion
methods.description: Verifies URL path transformation based on configuration.

methods.name: TestNote_WithToken
methods.description: Tests inclusion of authorization token in request headers.

methods.name: TestNote_FireAndForget
methods.description: Ensures the note sending is non-blocking even with slow server responses.

methods.name: TestNote_MultipleNotes
methods.description: Checks that multiple notes can be sent concurrently.
